runtime_profile.notes: transformers pinned to <5.0.0 for compatibility with diffusers at this commit. PyTorch installed from CPU-only index for smaller download.

notes: git and curl are pre-installed in the base image. Python 3.11.2 is available. The diffusers package is installed in editable mode from /workspace. transformers is pinned to <5.0.0 to avoid API incompatibilities with FLAX_WEIGHTS_NAME. Using python:3.11-slim base (not pytorch/pytorch) because official PyTorch images only offer CUDA variants which are unnecessarily large for CPU-only testing. PyTorch CPU version is installed via pip from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu for faster download.
